sources.snippet: Overview MinerU2.5-Pro-2605-1.2B is a document parsing model maintained by opendatalab that converts document images (PDFs and scans) into structured Markdown output. The model retains the 1.2B-parameter architecture of its predecessor but achieves state-of-the-art results through systematic data engineering rather than architectural changes.
